INDICATION: ___ female with sickle cell anemia and right 
hip 
avascular necrosis. Severe left hip pain. 
  
COMPARISON: None. 
  
AP PELVIS, SINGLE VIEW: Right greater than left sclerotic 
appearance of the femoral heads is in keeping with avascular 
necrosis, though the joint spaces are maintined and there is no 
cortical collapse. Chronic changes from sickle cell anemia 
involves the visualized lower lumbar vertebral bodies. There is 
no fracture or dislocation. The sacroiliac joints and pubic 
symphysis are preserved.  
  
IMPRESSION: Right great than left sclerotic appearance to the 
femoral heads is in keeping with avascular necrosis, however, 
MRI is more sensitive in the early evaluation of AVN.  
  

 
Brief Hospital Course:
___ year old woman with sickle cell crisis.

Sickle cell anemia, with pain crisis - Pain improved with 
intravenous fluids and pain control with dilaudid.  Plain films 
revealed possible AVN of the left hip and known AVN of the right 
hip.

Ortho - Patient with known AVN.  Pt was seen by the orthopedics 
service for evaluation of future hip replacement.  Patient to 
have outpatient MRI and f/u with ortho on an outpatient basis.
